name: Qurious Crafting - Relics (怪异炼化 - 遗物)
author: omp
description: Chaos relics generated per run with the Anthony algorithm. Each relic spends a rarity-scaled point budget on positive entries, with negative entries refunding points for more positives (qurious-crafting style). Standalone; no AutoAnthony dependency. Master switch plus per-group switches for the chaos relic pool, runtime hooks/tooltips, seed capture and the extra effect pool; disabling a group takes effect on the next run or load, never mid-run, and re-enabling the pool group requires a game restart because the chaos slots are registered at startup.
